raw_segments.text: Hold, while Prometheus is about it, I'll order a complete man after a desirable pattern.
In primus, fifty feet high in his socks, then chest mottled after the Thames tunnel.
Then legs with roots to him to stay in one place.
Then arms three feet through the wrist, no heart at all, brass forehead and about a quarter
of an acre of fine brains, and let me see, shall I order eyes to see outwards.
No but put a skylight on top of his head to illuminate inwards.
There, take the order and away."
